verdict.rationale: mise is a local CLI tool, so its programmatic surface is the documented CLI reference (mise-probe-4), which offers machine-readable output such as `--json` (mise-docs-35). A first-party MCP server also lets AI assistants inspect tools, tasks, env and config and run tasks (mise-docs-74). However, there is no documented HTTP/REST or library API: OpenAPI probes all returned 404 (mise-probe-3), so driving mise programmatically means shelling out to the CLI or using MCP. Missing for 10: a documented public HTTP/library API or schema, consistent JSON output documented across commands, and independent corroboration of programmatic use.
